page.layout: One page of continuous text, one column, no marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: tur, lædi posse non existimabam. Tantam fiduciam pariebant in animo meo
deinde meum in libro illo scribendo, testi-
antiquius, nihil charius unquam fuit, quàm
Card. Perronii comitatu vixi, qui po-
atus est, adscitus sum, qui inde Con-
men dedi, atque ab eo fere tempore à
stulante & ultra modum urgen-te, ad mortem usque indivulsus fui.

page.notes: The catchword "Si" at the lower right is partly unclear and marked [?]. A small mark at the end of the line "qvacunqve" looks like a stray stroke, not a hyphen, so the word is written whole. The spelling "qvàm" is read as quàm. Left-margin marks are scan artefacts, not printed text.
